Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_TX_LedCurrent_v1
Objects.description: LED current from the hall monitors on both regulators (COM1, COM2), refreshed once per complete burst. A slot's value is its peak current - twice its mean, since the carrier is 0.5 + 0.5 sin of the peak - so a lit slot should read the set current. Section summaries come first, then every slot: a slot that lights no string on a regulator reads near 0, which is how a stuck-on or dead string shows.

variables.name: bursts
variables.description: Bursts measured since power on; it steps each time the values below are refreshed

variables.name: zero
variables.description: Hall sensor reading at no current, COM1 and COM2; subtracted from every value below

variables.name: median
variables.description: Median slot current per section: DPTF COM1, DPTF COM2, DACS COM1, DACS COM2, ADS COM1, ADS COM2. The section's current; 0 with no settled slot

variables.name: min
variables.description: Lowest slot current per section, same order as median

variables.name: max
variables.description: Highest slot current per section, same order as median

variables.name: slots
variables.description: Lit slots measured per section in the burst, same order as median
